data.text: Glad we could all meet before heading out. My family taught me to leave enough fish for next month, and plenty of folks in our village depend on this lake. With 100 tons now, we can catch 50 total, leave 50 to double, and start next month full again. How about we each take 10 tons this month? That’s $10,000 apiece, with the same opportunity next month if we all stick to it. I’ll commit to that limit. John, what do you think?
